content:
maya: started security preflight for cluster-eu4-gpu-202 in eu-west4. main concerns: KMS/CMEK, HSM replication, service account impersonation, and secret rotation. tagging infra + security for quick checks.

ops-bot: cluster create job submitted for cluster-eu4-gpu-202 (reserved-gpu-2). provisioning steps queued.

sam: quick checklist:
- dedicate a KMS key/ring in eu-west4, consider replication to eu-west3 for DR
- create separate SAs: redwood-provisioner (pipeline), node SA (min perms), workload SAs
- prefer roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator for pipelines vs actAs
- Secret Manager + CMEK for bootstrap and runtime secrets
- run policy-scan for iam,secrets,kms,network

kevin: notes:
- never give nodes project-wide editor/owner
- HSM keys: separate key ring, restrict to ops-kms-binding and kms-admins
- log and export KMS audit to audit-exports-eu4 bucket

elaine: need proof of audit exports and a 48h temporary rotation plan for bootstrap secrets before handoff.

jordan: secrets flow: bootstrap token -> Secret Manager + CMEK, rotation 30d; workload secrets in Secret Manager with fine-grained IAM.

sam: applying example binding for token creator:
```
resource: projects/REDACTED/serviceAccounts/redwood-provisioner@PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com
role: roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
members:
  - serviceAccount:ci-runner@PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

kevin: enforce cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToEncrypt only for ops and kms-admins groups.

maya: question: replicate KMS cross-region or rely on model fallback? some regions delay HSM operations.

elaine: prefer local primary in eu-west4, replication only to vetted eu-west3; HSM replication needs InfoSec approval.

sam: running policy-scan now:
```
security-scan --cluster cluster-eu4-gpu-202 --checks iam,secrets,kms,network --output short
```

security-bot: scan complete: 3 findings (2 HIGH, 1 MED)
1) HIGH: node SA has roles/editor on project. (resource: nodepool-1) Remediate: remove editor, apply minimal roles.
2) HIGH: KMS key IAM includes allAuthenticatedUsers. Remediate: remove public bindings.
3) MED: secret rotation disabled for cluster-bootstrap-token. Recommend 30d.

maya: assigning tasks:
- sam: remove editor from node SA + verify
- kevin: fix KMS bindings, add ops-kms-binding
- jordan: enable rotation on bootstrap secret
- elaine: verify audit exports and sign off

sam: removed editor from nodepool-1 SA. granted compute.instanceAdmin.v1 and iam.serviceAccountUser only to provisioning pipeline. re-running scan.

security-bot: re-run: 1 finding (MED) - secret rotation still disabled on cluster-bootstrap-token.

jordan: enabled rotation: rotationPeriod=30d, updated CI to fetch secrets at deploy-time instead of baked images.

kevin: removed public binding from KMS, added group:ops-kms-binding@redwood.com. tightened key ring IAM for HSM use.

elaine: please provide audit export links for the last 90d for key ring; I need viewer on audit-exports-eu4.

maya: granted elaine read for 24h to audit-exports-eu4 and DMed link.

ops-bot: bootstrap finished: nodepools ready, GPU drivers installed, readiness checks passing.

security-bot: final scan: 0 HIGH findings, 1 MED - need documented decision on KMS replication + approver noted.

maya: added short rationale to infra runbook: "KMS primary in eu-west4; replication allowed to eu-west3 for DR; HSM replication requires InfoSec approval." tagging @elaine for signoff.

elaine: reviewed and approved. Conditions met: SA least-privilege, KMS bindings locked down, secrets rotated, audit access provided. security signoff given.

maya: ops will shift PROD traffic in ~2h. closing thread unless new issues arise. :thumbsup:

kevin: please paste final commands/scripts into runbook (orchestrate-iam.sh, kms-patch.sh). example remove public binding:
```
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/ring --member="allUsers" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```

maya: added scripts and linked audit exports in runbook. handoff complete.
